  • {{:Circlet of Mist}}
== Walkthrough == This quest begins with a High Elf named Joyce in the Temple of Solusek Ro. To get to her: Once inside the temple, go through the large gate and then through one of the two doors on the side. Somewhere in the series of small rooms, there is a door that will be hidden by another open door, so in each room look around when the doors are closed. (If you come to a bigger room, you've gone too far.) When you find the side door, go through it and follow it up the stairs. You will come to a balcony in the room mentioned above. Facing into the room, go left and you will find Joyce. You say, 'Hail, Joyce' : Joyce says 'I am Joyce of the Temple of Solusek Ro. I am the guardian of four of the items of the elementalist. If you are a magician, ask me about the [Robe of the Elements], the [clay bracelet], the [earthen boots] or the [Circlet of Mist].' You say, 'What Circlet of Mist?' :Joyce says 'The Circlet of Mist is a beautiful hoop that would look good atop your head. It produces a fine gleam, and is known to increase your mental power. Are you [interested in the circlet]?' You say, 'I am interested in the circlet.' :Joyce says 'I will be needing the proper components to craft the circlet of mist. Bring me a Globe of Mist from a festering hag, a Water Ring from a Tidal Lord in Dagnor's Cauldron, a Ring of Evoluoy from an alligator in Cazic Thule, and a Sapphire. Do this, I will craft it for you.' [Hand in the items] :Joyce says 'You have done well. You are truly a powerful Magician. Here is your Circlet of Mist.' Your faction standing with TempleofSolusekRo got better. Your faction standing with ShadowedMen got worse.
